Step 1: 1012 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century year not divisible by 400).  
Step 2: Aug 30, 1012 + 218 days.  
From Aug 30 to end of Aug: 1 day (Aug 30 → Aug 31).  
September: 30 days → total 31 days.  
October: 31 days → total 62 days.  
November: 30 days → total 92 days.  
December: 31 days → total 123 days.  
Remaining days: 218 − 123 = 95 days into 1013.  
January 1013: 31 days → 64 left.  
February 1013: 28 days (1013 not leap) → 36 left.  
March: 31 days → 5 left.  
April 5, 1013.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1013-04-05
